g.title: PI
g.text: Physical pin numbers (odd = inner row from the SD-card end). i2c3 on BCM 4/5 needs dtoverlay=i2c3 in config.txt and has NO on-board pull-ups. w1-gpio must stay off (it defaults to BCM 4).

g.title: W_MLX
g.text: to the turret: leave a service loop for tilt

g.title: MLX
g.text: On i2c3 (BCM 4/5) ALONE so it can run at 1 MHz. BCM 4/5 have no pull-ups: if the module has none either, add 4.7 kΩ SDA→3V3 and SCL→3V3. Rides beside the webcam on the tilt bracket.

g.title: TOF_F
g.text: VL53L1X ToF FRONT (0x29 → re-addressed 0x30 by XSHUT)
Both ToFs share I2C-1. At boot the Pi holds FRONT XSHUT low, gives REAR 0x29… then raises FRONT and moves it to 0x30.

g.title: TOF_R
g.text: XSHUT on BCM 27 so the Pi can reset it independently.

g.title: MIC
g.text: L/R tied to GND = left channel. On the post front face, 120 mm up (assembly.py).

g.title: PULL
g.text: 2 × 4.7 kΩ i2c3 pull-ups (only if the MLX module has none)
Meter the module first: SDA to GND must read ≤ 3.3 V when powered alone.
